title: Nicolas Cage and Antonio Banderas will star in True Detective season five.
summary: Cage will play Henry Logan, and Banderas will play Rai Garcia. The series is set to enter production in 2027 , and showrunner Issa López will return after the reasonably well-received season four, Night Country.
